resources.string: Default for bike routes: how strongly to prefer cycleways and cycle lanes. It relies on OpenStreetMap tags, which are more complete in some areas than in others.
Standard bike routing, which already favours cycleways and tagged cycle lanes.
Prefers cycleways and cycle lanes, with some detours.
Strongly prefers cycleways and cycle lanes, even with long detours.
Uses only cycleways and roads tagged for bikes. Often finds no route.
No route found using only cycle infrastructure. Try Prefer.
